paragraphs: I am applying for the Service Desk Manager role at Fabrikam. For the past five years I have led a team of 6 technicians supporting about 900 employees across 4 sites.

With our service desk manager, I cut our open backlog from 410 to 120 tickets in 5 months by adding triage rules and a daily stand-up. I also automated new-hire laptop setup with Intune Autopilot, which brought setup time from about 3 hours to 40 minutes per device.
I would welcome the chance to talk about how this work fits your team.
